acceptance.given: The candidate authoring standard and frozen A01 artifact-check selector are available for foundation verification.

oracle.expected: The standard substantively defines references for Skill authors. Independent artifact assertions identify that definition and reject controlled variants that remove its substantive content or retain only its heading. Derived check evidence retains authorizes=[].
forbidden: The standard omits a reference definition.
A reference heading or incidental keyword alone satisfies the definition requirement.
Validator pass status or file existence substitutes for inspecting the definition.
An artifact assertion failure, missing import, absent planned test, environment failure, timeout or missing human approval is classified as expected-red.
oracle.observable: During foundation artifact verification and terminal regression, test_a01 reads the actual standard as UTF-8 and independently checks its reference definition; controlled deletion and heading-only variants must trigger the corresponding AssertionError.

acceptance.then: The standard contains an inspectable, substantive reference definition, and the artifact check detects its independent omission.
acceptance.when: The A01 foundation selector evaluates the standard's reference-definition contract and its controlled omission variants.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a01 with independently bound reference-definition parameters. Inspect docs/standards/skill-authoring-standard.md directly; removal of its reference definition or retention of only its heading must cause the reference-specific AssertionError. Use the declared targeted argv with a caller-enforced 300-second timeout. This is an artifact guard, not a runtime expected-red observation; unavailable production imports, absent tests and environment failures remain blockers.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Within the shared foundation context, define references substantively in the production standard and verify that definition through an independent A01 artifact assertion.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only candidate foundation changes while preserving pre-existing content, historical evidence and existing protocol authorities. No live database, Hosted workspace or runtime-state migration is involved.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard is being defined -> its references are substantively defined and independently artifact-checked.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The reference-specific A01 assertions execute without skips or harness errors, detect controlled omission and heading-only variants, and inspect the actual candidate standard. Derived evidence has authorizes=[]. Freeze tests/helpers before formal RED; production changes exclude those snapshots. Shared foundation changes invalidate affected proofs. Use applicable predecessor regression before one current whole-plan terminal run over all four modules with a 600-second timeout. Preserve existing CER/Q7/Q8 ownership and historical failures; do not fabricate receipts or ADR acceptance. The missing first real validator entry remains a protocol blocker until its existing owner can establish execution legally, never a causal RED.
